name: scroll
description: Scroll the active tab's viewport in a direction by N viewport-units (1.0 = one full page). Pass an element index to scroll INSIDE that element instead of the viewport.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: How far to scroll, in viewport-units. Default 1.0 (one full page). Use 0.5 for half a page, 2.0 for two pages.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Optional element index to scroll INSIDE (instead of scrolling the viewport). The element must be a scrollable container.
